title: RAW UNREVIEWED: overt dual agreement constrains predicate scope over two written heads
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. A number-bearing modifier and its single-participant relatives must share one lexical writing key across complete records. If its source-supported dual analysis is adopted, the property belongs to both overt coordinated heads, not just the nearest head or an unnamed collective. This couples morphological value with truth-condition scope rather than guessing a count word from flowers.

design.scope: Prospective meaning constraint. No manuscript observation, target nomination, decoder, experiment or confirmation is performed.
design.access: Existing cached source prose and finalized predecessor reports only. No new target content, images, source fetch, reserve, admission or contact. f84/f84r remain sealed.
design.structural_baseline: Word spaces and directed reusable parts are evidence; a learned segmentation is not one proven morpheme parser. Whole-form residuals GDT608 remain. No EVA/BPE alphabet, default language or English whole-word dictionary is selected.
design.retention_not_readiness: RAW retention does not assert that source agreement, word identity or target correspondence is established. Root must inspect full primary predecessors and freeze selection independently.
design.hypothesis: One finite source-language morphology-to-writing rule preserves an agreement contrast and the same property lemma across single-head and two-head clauses. Number morphology selects the overt coordination as the modifier scope; it is not a freely added BOTH operator.
complete_source_units: PGP40129/T-S Ar.43.225, PEACH recto5 through recto13 before pomegranate
POMEGRANATE recto13 through verso5 before quince
QUINCE verso5 through verso14 before apple
design.exact_claim_bearing_clause: recto15–16: מקויא ללמעדה / ואלכבד אלחארתין מסכן ללקי
design.source_fact: The complete coordinated stomach/liver clause and the translation support אלחארתין as a working dual agreement candidate. Its visible -תין is retained; exact case and the linguistic analysis are not independently proven here. Quince verso6 ללמעדה אלחארה supplies the single-head hot-stomach relative; cold bare/prefixed forms remain separate source classes.
design.consequence: Under the dual/distributive reading, hot(stomach) and hot(liver) are both committed. A later complete reading that makes only the liver hot, or predicates heat only of a newly invented stomach-liver mixture, changes that scope. No treatment event or degree is inferred.
rivals: Nearest-head modifier: only liver receives the property.
Collective-only property: the pair receives a property without either member commitment.
Invariant lexical class marker: the ending has no number-sensitive scope consequence.
Source dual reading incorrect or writing mechanism neutralizes number: these remain serious alternatives.
new_contract_vs_predecessors: IDEA77 proposes selected participant cardinality versus lexical category using an unbound flower-count route. This proposal instead fixes a source-attested coordinated two-head construction, a one-head lexical relative and truth-condition scope; it does not reopen PHF001 count-label recurrence.

IDEA45 already has distributivity versus collective scope. The added constraint is a source-owned inflectional relation to a single-head clause under one spelling key, so a bare recurring whole labelled EACH is insufficient.
IDEA337/339 already have articles and coordinated opposed property nouns. Here the two coordinated items are different body heads receiving one modifier, not a heat/cold property pair.

GDT1105 pays separate owner grammars over thermal candidates. The proposed number rule must decide the coordination scope from written morphology and reuse, without field-specific owner choices; no inherited thermal meanings are adopted.
precise_new_measurement_needed: Within the already owned source packet, independently verify the single/dual property lemma, overt heads and modifier scope, with case/reading alternatives preserved. No new source intake is required.

For one root-nominated complete admitted target unit plus two nonseed complete consumers, retain all groups and a prospective common form-family key. The needed observation is an overt one-head versus two-head contrast plus a later separately written member predicate or modifier attachment that differs between nearest-head and both-head readings. No such target pair is supplied here.
design.changed_falsifier: A fixed common writing key must predict the agreement variant and both member attachments in nonseed complete units. Reject this exact construction if a securely bound consumer permits only one-member scope, if the single/dual relationship requires per-word/per-occurrence exceptions, or if all contrast disappears under source reading alternatives. Missing owner/scope remains missing binding, not a falsified grammar.
counterexamples_and_gates: Dual morphology alone need not prove distributive predication for every property; source syntax and the property must support the two commitments.
A collective renderer can emit member fields without encoding distributivity. A target occurrence must derive scope from the same lexical/grammatical rule, not the renderer output.
GDT965/966 fixed word-preserving Semitic channels remain failed. No resegmentation or repair of those channels is selected.
PGP dating is not secure pre1420; modern transcription/translation is not a demonstrated Voynich witness.

smallest_future_step.decision: If a repeated form family cannot bind the specified contrast, retain raw but do not select a target test. Do not build a corpus or enlarge the dictionary.

design.mechanism: Overt source dual agreement fixes shared predicate scope over two coordinated written heads under one inflectional writing key.
design.unit: Complete PGP40129 pomegranate and quince records, then a separately selected admitted full target with two nonseed consumers.
design.contrast: Dual both-head property commitment versus nearest-head or collective-only scope, preserving single-head lexical relatives.
design.prediction: Same property family predicts both the agreement variant and each overt participant commitment without owner-specific choices.
design.falsifier: A fixed common writing key must predict the agreement variant and both member attachments in nonseed complete units. Reject this exact construction if a securely bound consumer permits only one-member scope, if the single/dual relationship requires per-word/per-occurrence exceptions, or if all contrast disappears under source reading alternatives. Missing owner/scope remains missing binding, not a falsified grammar.
